feed.title: BIM Takeoff Research & Publications
feed.subtitle: Expert analysis on BIM 5D cost estimation, AI in construction, and industry trends

entry.title: The $40 Trillion Construction Crisis: Challenges Reshaping a Global Industry
entry.summary: Comprehensive analysis of the construction industry's existential challenges: a $40 trillion infrastructure gap by 2040, workforce collapse with 41% retiring by 2031, productivity stagnation, and the urgent need for digital transformation.

entry.title: The Endemic Failure of Construction Project Delivery: Why 91.5% of Projects Fail
entry.summary: Research analysis of why construction projects consistently fail. Oxford University data reveals 91.5% exceed budgets or schedules, with mean cost overruns of 62%. Understanding the structural causes behind the iron law of megaprojects.

entry.title: AI w przedmiarach budowlanych: między deklaracjami marketingowymi a rzeczywistością
entry.summary: Kompleksowa analiza oprogramowania AI do przedmiarów ujawnia oszczędności czasu 40-60% wobec deklarowanych 80-90%, przy czym wszystkie deklaracje dokładności pochodzą od producentów. RICS wprowadza obowiązek nadzoru specjalistów—technologia wspomaga, nie zastępuje wiedzy rzeczoznawcy.

entry.title: AI Quantity Takeoff in Construction: The Gap Between Marketing Claims and Reality
entry.summary: Comprehensive analysis of AI takeoff software reveals 40-60% time savings versus marketed 80-90%, with all accuracy claims vendor self-reported. RICS now mandates professional oversight—the technology augments rather than replaces quantity surveyor expertise.

entry.title: The 70% Price Myth: What Really Wins Construction Tenders
entry.summary: Data-driven analysis debunking the '70% price' myth in construction procurement. Research reveals 40-50% of evaluation is non-price criteria where accurate cost estimation and BIM visualization deliver measurable win rate improvements.

entry.title: The Century-Old Innovation That Keeps Failing: What Really Happened to Modular Construction
entry.summary: After 100 years of promises and £500 million in recent UK failures, why does modular construction still capture barely 5-8% of Western markets while Sweden quietly builds 84% of homes this way? A data-driven analysis of what works, what doesn't, and why.

entry.title: Czy AI zastąpi kosztorysantów? Rzeczywistość cyfrowej rewolucji w budownictwie
entry.summary: Analiza wpływu sztucznej inteligencji na zawód kosztorysanta oparta na danych. Badania pokazują, że AI przekształci, ale nie zastąpi profesji - ale wykonawcy stoją przed pytaniem o 2,1 mln PLN dotyczącym automatyzacji.

entry.title: Will AI Replace Quantity Surveyors? The Reality Behind Construction's Digital Revolution
entry.summary: Data-driven analysis of AI's impact on quantity surveying. Research shows AI will transform, not replace, the profession - but contractors face a £495,680 question about automation versus human expertise.

entry.title: BIM Adoption at Tender Stages: Why Contractors Resist and What Poland Can Learn from the UK
entry.summary: Deep analysis of BIM adoption barriers during tendering, comparing UK success (73% adoption) with Poland's challenges (8.9% contractor adoption). Comprehensive policy recommendations for Poland's 2030 mandate.
